Additionally, the name Samritaan serves as a daily reminder of the importance of seeking prosperity not just in material terms but also in spiritual terms. historical_references.reference: Samritaan was a famous Jaina monk and scholar during the Gupta Empire in the 5th century CE. He was a disciple of Haribhadra Suri and is known for his commentary on the 'Yogavasisha' of Haribhadra Suri, which is a seminal work on Jaina ascetic practices and Yoga.

historical_references.reference: Samritaan is also mentioned in the 'Prabandha-Chintamani' of Hemacandra, a 12th century Jaina scholar. He is listed among the great Jaina scholars of the Bhagavati sect and is known for his works on Jaina logic, metaphysics, and grammar.
